their AN to ORB Adapters are manufactured to provide a perfect fit and seal when paired with ColorFittings AN fittings, which are specifically engineered for use with E85, ethanol-based fuels, and race fuels. • Construction: Precision CNC-machined in the USA. (6061-T6 Billet Aluminum for fittings)
